notes.title: Flem Soundtrack is Out Now!
notes.notes:
You can now get the complete chiptune soundtrack of Flem as DLC for $0.99.

Composed by Jens Kristian Mørkeby Rimau, the Flem soundtrack is heavily inspired by the carefree, happy-go-lucky 8-bit music of classic games.

Tracklist:

1. Title Theme
2. Ambient
3. Spring
4. Summer
5. Fall
6. Winter
7. Mystic
8. Bonus (Unused)
